newsitem.title: USA: New PAX owner still plans equity fund.
newsitem.headline: New PAX owner still plans equity fund.

text.p: The new owners of the PAX World Management, adviser to the PAX World Fund, intend to go forward with plans for a new equity growth fund.
PAX announced Thursday it was sold to members of the Shadek family of New Jersey. The PAX founders had said they wanted to start an equity fund.

A spokesman for Shadek said they intend to file a proposal for the new fund with the Securities and Exchange Commission "between now and Thanksgiving," and hope the fund will be declared effective in early 1997.
PAX World is a "socially responsible," no-load balanced mutual fund, with more than $500 million in assets.
